title: EventBus multi-owner repeated broadcast stability contract

contract.multi_owner_registration: Multiple plugin owners can independently register listeners for the same event
contract.repeated_broadcast: Repeated EventBus.emit() calls deliver the event to every currently registered listener
contract.delivery_once: Each registered listener receives each emitted event exactly once
contract.cross_owner_delivery: Broadcast delivery is independent of listener ownership
contract.source_metadata: Each delivered event preserves the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.registry_stability: Repeated broadcast delivery does not modify the listener registry
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful throughout repeated multi-owner delivery cycles
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration and emit operations require the events permission
